docs.title: Home
docs.text:
Production-grade agent infrastructure for AI applications. Build, deploy, and operate LLM-powered agents with the Kneo Agent SDK and the Kneo Agent Platform.

  • Kneo Agent SDK

    A framework-agnostic Python library for building agents with composable tools, MCP integrations, middleware, streaming, human-in-the-loop control, and observability.

    Read the SDK docs

  • Kneo Agent Platform

    A service and control plane that runs agents in production — YAML spec compiler, FastAPI service, Typer CLI, durable run state, pause/resume, and pluggable persistence.

    Read the platform docs
